island.name: Weather & time
island.description: Talking about the weather and the seasons, telling the time, days and dates.

sentences.en: What's the weather like today?
sentences.note: "Vreme" is weather; "timp" is time — don't mix them up.

sentences.en: It's warm and sunny outside.
sentences.ro: E cald și e soare afară.

sentences.en: It's raining, take an umbrella.
It's very cold this morning.
sentences.ro: E foarte frig în dimineața asta.

sentences.en: It snowed a lot last night.
It's not going to rain tomorrow.
sentences.note: "O să" + verb is the everyday future, much more common than "voi ploua".

sentences.en: How many degrees is it outside?
The wind is strong today.
I love autumn more than summer.
sentences.ro: Îmi place toamna mai mult decât vara.

sentences.en: What time is it?
sentences.note: Literally "how much is the clock" — the standard way to ask the time.

sentences.en: It's half past six.
It's a quarter to nine.
What day is it today?
My birthday is on the twelfth of March.
sentences.ro: Ziua mea e pe doisprezece martie.
sentences.note: "Ziua mea" (my day) is how Romanians say "my birthday".

sentences.en: I don't have time right now.
We still have half an hour.
sentences.ro: Mai avem o jumătate de oră.

sentences.en: It gets dark early in December.
The days are getting longer now.
sentences.ro: Zilele se fac mai lungi acum.

sentences.en: Are you free on Saturday morning?
The weather was better last week.
sentences.ro: Vremea a fost mai bună săptămâna trecută.
